transcript: Speaker A: गाड़ी से दो उतरे, एक चिल्ला रहा था, दूसरे ने इंग्लिश में माफ़ी मांगी, लड़ाई वहीं ख़त्म हो गई। [Two got out of the car, one was shouting, the other apologized in English, the fight ended right there.] Speaker B: अरे अंधे हो क्या? दिखता नहीं है? गाड़ी देख मेरी स्क्रैच आ गया। पैसा कौन देगा? [Are you blind? Can't you see? Look at my car, it got scratched. Who will pay?] Speaker C: Sir, I sincerely apologize. It was completely my fault. I should have been more careful. Please let me know the repair cost, I will cover it right away. I'm really sorry for the inconvenience. Speaker B: वो... हाँ... मतलब... देख के चलाया करो भाई। [Oh... yes... I mean... drive carefully, brother.] Speaker C: Absolutely sir, you're right. Here's my number. Please get the estimate and share it with me. I'll settle it today itself. Again, I'm very sorry. Go ahead.] Speaker D: पापा मुझे लगा वो आदमी मारने वाला था। आपने क्या किया? [Dad, I thought that man was going to beat us. What did you do?] Speaker C: बेटा, इंग्लिश बोली। [Son, I spoke English.] Speaker D: बस? मतलब? [Just that? Meaning?] Speaker C: देख बेटा, जब कोई चिल्लाता है और तुम भी चिल्लाओगे तो लड़ाई होती है। और जब तुम इंग्लिश में शांत तरीके से बात करते हो ना, तो सामने वाले का पूरा मूड बदल जाता है। उसको लगता है ये पढ़ा-लिखा आदमी है, शरीफ है, इससे लड़ने का कोई फायदा नहीं। [Look son, when someone shouts and you shout back, a fight happens. But when you speak calmly in English, the other person's entire mood changes. He thinks this is an educated, decent man, there's no point in fighting him.] Speaker D: पर पापा, आपको तो इंग्लिश नहीं आती थी। मम्मी हमेशा कहती थी... [But Dad, you didn't know English. That night, I downloaded the 'English Seekho' app. It had a ₹1 trial.] Speaker D: ऐप से इंग्लिश सीख ली? summary: A father defuses a road rage incident by apologizing calmly in English, demonstrating to his son how the language commands respect and prevents conflict.
